name: WARNING: Raw Shallots & Scallion White Bulbs (Fructan Bomb)
whyItWorks: Raw diced shallots and the white bulbous bases of green onions commonly sprinkled over dishes. Heavy concentration of fructans that undergo rapid colonic fermentation, producing severe bloating and urgency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request 'no onions, shallots, or scallion whites' on restaurant dishes. The green leaf tops of scallions are low-FODMAP and much better tolerated.
